configuration.comment: select all columns from Appointment table, filtered by the year of scheduledstart is equal to current year and the month of scheduledstart is equal to next month
configuration.query: Give a list of the appointments for coming next month.
configuration.rephrase: The query will list out all appointments in the coming next month.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT * FROM [Appointment] WHERE YEAR([scheduledstart]) = YEAR(GETDATE()) and MONTH([scheduledstart]) = MONTH(DATEADD(month, 1, GETDATE()))
